{{Quote|A group of mercenaries from the area, Strehkforce mercenaries. They're commanded by Evan Strehk and Maris Fahrs.|[[Vance Groten]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" />}}
'''Evan Strehk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Strehkforce]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He operated out of a Strehkforce camp outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] alongside Commander [[Maris Fahrs]].<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Strehkforce mercenaries went to Dee'ja Peak and stole a [[Stonewall Labs]] [[security beacon]] from [[Vance Groten]]. Spacers who were working with Groten later went to the mercenary [[Strehkforce Camp|camp]], in the mountains, to recover it. The spacers attacked the Strehkforce mercenaries and killed Evan Strehk and Maris Fahrs.<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Evan Strehk appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Evan Strehk was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
